# skpatch

> Patch at AI speed.

skpatch is SKWorld's patching program for a sovereign fleet: hosts and container images both,
kept current on a known, kept cadence instead of by memory. Every image it tracks is pinned to a
SHA-256 digest, never a bare tag. A daily, read-only job inventories every running service (image,
tag, digest, exposure class) and a daily SBOM job uploads a CycloneDX bill of materials for every
distinct image digest into skbom, a Dependency-Track instance that re-matches those SBOMs against
NVD, GHSA, and OSV continuously, not just on ingest. Renovate opens the pin-bump pull requests on
its own weekly schedule, plus an immediate security pull request the moment a pin matches a known
vulnerability. Every change, whatever triggered it, runs the same release gate (a build and test
harness) before it is tagged and deployed. The lane a finding takes depends on severity, fix
availability, and exposure: same-day deploy for a critical with a fix on a public or SSO-gated
service, a weekly batch for the rest, and a monthly review from the skbom dashboard for the long
tail. The underlying host packages patch through the same discipline, one layer down, via an
SSO-gated update dashboard.

## About smilinTux

skpatch is part of the **smilinTux sovereign AI ecosystem**, a suite of open-source tools built by
its creators to give humans and AI agents genuine, authentic infrastructure they can own and
trust. No corporate clouds, no black-box SaaS middlemen. MIT License.

Other ecosystem projects: [SKWorld](https://skworld.io), [SKStacks](https://skstacks.skworld.io), [sksec](https://sksec.skworld.io), [skhub](https://skhub.skworld.io), [skgateway](https://skgateway.skworld.io), [Lumina](https://lumina.skworld.io)
